interpretation: The exact coefficient relationship and shared electricity-production documentation indicate an electrical-energy unit conversion, rather than demonstrated useful thermal output. decisions: Do not bind the published MJ-labelled record as an established useful-heat counterpart solely because the unit says MJ.
Do not infer annual delivered thermal output or thermal efficiency from receiver power divided by rated electrical power.
Keep the verified CSP electricity mapping and original source pins unchanged.

Inspect original thermal-production evidence or a complete native useful-solar-heat screening proxy with explicit heat-grade and technology limitations before enabling the two solar roles. No positive IAM volume may be silently discarded.
native_frontier: Several native standalone flat-plate collector processes provide useful hot-water heat without auxiliary fuel, unlike combined solar/fuel or PVT regeneration systems. Their hot-water grade, residential scale and Swiss climate require explicit review before industrial/district use.
